post.summary:
Comparing quotes for a hurricane-rated garage door in Miami-Dade? You will likely see the letters NOA, short for Notice of Acceptance. It is the county approval for a specific door model, and it lists the manufacturer, approved sizes, pressure ratings and an expiration date. Each rated door should also carry a permanent label, so a flashlight and a photo of the side track or bottom edge can help a technician look up the paperwork.

Before you sign, ask which model is quoted, whether the approval is current, whether it covers your opening size and how the door will be anchored. Our hurricane-rated garage door team can talk through options and give you a free quote. The new guide explains how to read the approval step by step.
